defaultBehavior: dry-run; no writes or task changes without --apply

supportedTargets.cli: An isolated, named profile; does not edit the main Codex config.
supportedTargets.desktop: Explicitly updates only the selected root model/provider and a project-owned provider block, with a protected backup.

safety.concurrentEditPolicy: Checks before writes; no interprocess file lock is guaranteed.

requiredHumanOrEnvironmentActions: Choose CLI or desktop and authorize the intended configuration changes.
Ensure OmniRoute is running and provider accounts/model access are configured.
Provide the existing OmniRoute API key securely through the environment, not the AI prompt.
Approve any relevant operating-system permissions and any billable/quota-using real model test.
Validate the actual requested client and the next Windows reboot when applicable.
notes: The bridge includes normalization revision 2 for Grok web-search action.type other replay.
A local managed-requirements file, an unowned task/profile/provider, unsupported TOML, or later edits require manual review.
The doctor checks local gateway and bridge readiness only; it cannot prove desktop behavior or a reboot.
Example catalogs and model IDs are not account entitlements or guaranteed to exist.
